verdict.rationale: Linear documents agent features: Write with Agent drafts project updates, Linear Agent writes code and edits text, and Loops run recurring workflows. None of the evidence describes asking a question and getting an instant answer with citations back to workspace content. Third-party connectors (ChatGPT deep research, Notion AI, Claude via MCP) are external tools rather than Linear's own capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
